description: Standardized Dice Chess endgame benchmark suite for asymmetric and sparse endings

positions.name: K+Q vs K (Defender Centralized)
positions.description: White King on e2, Queen on d1; Black King centralized on e5 with 8 escape squares.

positions.name: K+Q vs K (Defender on Edge)
positions.description: White King on e1, Queen on d1; Black King on edge e8 with 5 escape squares.

positions.name: K+Q vs K (Defender Cornered)
positions.description: White King on e1, Queen on d1; Black King cornered on h8 with 3 escape squares.

positions.name: K+Q vs K (Close Kings Race)
positions.description: White King on e2, Queen on a1; Black King on e4 just 2 squares away from White King. Tests whether lone king seizes proximity to threaten the enemy king or retreats.

positions.name: K+R vs K (Defender Centralized)
positions.description: White King on e1, Rook on a1; Black King centralized on e5.

positions.name: K+R vs K (Defender on Edge)
positions.description: White King on d1, Rook on a1; Black King on back rank d8.

positions.name: K+R vs K (Defender Cornered)
positions.description: White King on e1, Rook on h1; Black King cornered on a8.

positions.name: K+R vs K (Close Kings Race)
positions.description: White King on f1, Rook on a8; Black King on f3 close to White King.

positions.name: K+2P vs K (Connected Passed Pawns)
positions.description: White King on e1 with connected passed pawns on d4/e4; Black King on d7 blockading.

positions.name: K+2P vs K (Split Passed Pawns)
positions.description: White King on e1 with split passed pawns on b4 and g4; Black King on e5.

positions.name: K+2P vs K (Advanced Pawns on 6th Rank)
positions.description: White advanced pawns on c6/d6 threatening immediate promotion; Black King on d8 blockading.

positions.name: K+P vs K (King in Front / Key Squares)
positions.description: Classical key squares pawn ending: White King on e5 ahead of pawn e4; Black King on e7 holds opposition.

positions.name: K+P vs K (Outside Passed Pawn Race)
positions.description: Outside passed pawn on a4 tests the square-of-the-pawn rule and king intercept speed.

positions.name: K+P vs K (Rook Pawn Corner Defense)
positions.description: Rook pawn on a4 with defensive cornering dynamics.

positions.name: K+B+N vs K (Defender Centralized)
positions.description: White King, Bishop (dark) and Knight; Black King centralized on e5.

positions.name: K+B+N vs K (Wrong Corner a8)
positions.description: Black King on a8 (wrong corner, opposite square color from White dark-squared Bishop).

positions.name: K+B+N vs K (Right Corner h8)
positions.description: Black King on h8 (right corner, matching square color of White dark-squared Bishop).
